source_title: What Should I Do If I Can T Complete The Payment
snippet_primary: "Payments processed from the App Stores (not by Domestika) are generally considered local transactions. If you have problems with international purchases, please consider trying to complete your order using the Domestika app."
subject_exact: Pagos procesados desde las App Stores (no por Domestika) generalmente considerados transacciones locales; sugerencia de completar la orden vía la app de Domestika ante problemas con compras internacionales
parser_notes: 'the App Stores' es referencia genérica a tiendas de apps, no una plataforma nombrada; no se incluye en platforms.
